title: Dunderhead Deputies in Farmyard Follies
description: In a classic from yesteryear, Officer Joe and the Dunderhead Deputies are on the hunt for Italian Pete who has his hands in the chicken coop.
altHero: Italian Pete, in a striped prisoner’s outfit, stuffing chickens into a big bag
alt1: Officer Joe gasping at wanted poster of Italian Pete while standing next to him
alt2: Police Patrol car full of officers
alt3: Pete nailing up a wanted poster of Officer Joe
alt4: Officer Joe in hell getting poked by demons
